en-US.description: A local, cross-platform DNS management desktop app that brings domains and DNS records from multiple cloud providers into one interface.
en-US.longDescription: Domain Buddy is a local, cross-platform DNS management desktop application. It consolidates domains and DNS records from multiple cloud providers into a single interface, with support for DNSPod, Cloudflare, Volcano Engine DNS, and Aliyun DNS — a fit for individual developers and small teams who use several DNS services and do not want to switch consoles constantly. Sensitive credentials are kept in the operating system credential store, and DNS requests go directly to each provider's official HTTPS endpoints.

zh-CN.description: 本地运行的多平台域名解析管理桌面应用，将多家云服务商的域名与解析记录集中到一个界面中管理。
zh-CN.longDescription: Domain Buddy 是一个本地运行的多平台 DNS 管理桌面应用。它把多个云厂商的域名与解析记录集中到一个界面中，支持 DNSPod、Cloudflare、火山引擎 DNS 与阿里云 DNS，适合同时使用多家 DNS 服务、又不想频繁切换控制台的个人开发者和团队。敏感凭据保存在操作系统凭据库中，DNS 请求直接发往各服务商的官方 HTTPS 接口。
zh-CN.name: Domain Buddy
